subject: [Invite] AI/ML Leaders Dinner - 29 May @ Aerlume Seattle
text:
Hi [NAME],

Heard great things about your work at Anduril on model training for
autonomous sensemaking. So wanted to invite you to an intimate dinner our
co-founders, [SENDER] & [SENDER], will be hosting for AI leaders in Seattle - we'd
love for you to join if you're interested / can make it?

We've booked a private dinning room at Aerlume Seattle on Thursday, May
29th, 6:30-9:30 pm, capping attendance at 30 people. Attendees include
customers as well as founders & technical leaders from top AI/ML VC-backed
scale-ups working with CV in the autonomous and DefenceTech space - i.e.
Skydio, Allen Control Systems, Woven by Toyota.

Bit of context on Encord...we're a computer vision scale-up (recently
raised a $30M Series B) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation,
workflow management and model evaluation under one platform.

Let me know if you're interested/free - happy to send over the full details.

subject: Scaling AI data pipelines for UK investment
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Noticed that [COMPANY] has recently been scaling its Data & AI teams, and having seen the recent plans to invest over £400m in the UK, thought I'd reach out to introduce myself.

I lead the Drones & Robotics team here at Encord, working with a few of your adjacent peers (including Shield AI, Dedrone, & DroneShield) - helping them to move away from open-source starter tools like CVAT + Voxel 51, and towards a more scalable Enterprise-grade data management solution that brings together multimodal data curation & annotation in a single platform. 

If this sounds interesting, would be happy to chat & share what we're seeing work well for our other Drone & Robotics partners.

Let me know if you're be open to a 30-minute chat early next week? Tuesdays or Wednesdays usually work for me,
